title: Migrating and Maintaining PyTorch Projects knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Reading release notes” in this lesson?
options: This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Turn the expected behavior into a repeatable check, include at least one failure case, and document dependency or data-trust assumptions.
This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
questions.answer_key: Turn the expected behavior into a repeatable check, include at least one failure case, and document dependency or data-trust assumptions.
questions.explanation: Reading release notes: Turn the expected behavior into a repeatable check, include at least one failure case, and document dependency or data-trust assumptions.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Pinning compatible dependencies”, what should a learner verify?
options: Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
confirm dependency versions, input/error behavior, reproducibility records, quality metrics, and a recovery plan for failures or upgrades.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
questions.answer_key: confirm dependency versions, input/error behavior, reproducibility records, quality metrics, and a recovery plan for failures or upgrades.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: confirm dependency versions, input/error behavior, reproducibility records, quality metrics, and a recovery plan for failures or upgrades.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Deprecated or changed APIs”?
options: Do not claim a production deployment or performance gain without target-environment tests, monitoring, and documented limitations.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
questions.answer_key: Do not claim a production deployment or performance gain without target-environment tests, monitoring, and documented limitations.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not claim a production deployment or performance gain without target-environment tests, monitoring, and documented limitations.
